8:

12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.

## Objective
- Finish the existing game in the repository as a complete, playable experience.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Preserve the existing Turkish-language 3D Busan patrol game and UI rather than replacing its design.
- Fix event timing and callout NPC positioning so events begin during play and their characters remain at their callout locations.

## Work State
### Completed
- Explored the existing game, UI, and controls in `index.html`, `game.js`, and `style.css`.
- Changed `activateEvent()` to avoid activating before the shift starts or while another incident is active.
- Changed event activation to reposition the target NPC at the event location and set the next-event timer.
- Replaced delayed `setTimeout(activateEvent,10500)` with scheduling through `state.nextEventAt`.
- Changed the start button to schedule the first event two seconds into the shift.
- Ran `node --check game.js` successfully.
- Started the local server and launched the game in Playwright; clicked the start button and captured/read `screenshots/game.jpg`.

### Active
- Finish browser verification, inspect current gameplay screenshot/console as appropriate, and identify any remaining issues.
- Report the completed work and brief assumptions to the user.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect `screenshots/game.jpg` and verify the event/callout interaction after waiting for the scheduled event.
2. Check for gameplay issues and make targeted fixes, then rerun syntax/browser checks.
3. Provide a concise completion summary, including assumptions and test results.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: 3D scene, movement, events, UI interaction, and recent gameplay-loop fixes.
- `index.html`: Existing game interface and controls.
- `style.css`: Existing responsive visual design.
- `screenshots/game.jpg`: Latest captured gameplay screenshot.

## Important Context
- The browser console showed one missing `/favicon.ico` 404 and WebGL software-rendering performance warnings; no JavaScript errors were reported.
- Changes are uncommitted.
